title: Add manual invoice compliance fields with validation

acceptanceCriteria: Supplier Legal Name field is present in the invoice details form
Field is marked as required with visual indicator
Validation error displays if field is empty when attempting PDF generation
Field value appears in the generated invoice PDF

requirements.text: Enforce validation that at least one line item must be present before allowing PDF download

quotes: At least one line item is required

acceptanceCriteria: Validation prevents PDF download when line items array is empty
Clear error message displays when user attempts to download with no line items
PDF download button is disabled or shows validation error when no line items exist

requirements.text: Add validation that invoice grand total must be greater than zero before allowing PDF download

quotes: Invoice grand total must be greater than zero

acceptanceCriteria: Validation checks that calculated grand total is greater than zero
Clear error message displays when grand total is zero or negative
PDF download is prevented when grand total validation fails

requirements.text: Display all validation errors in a consolidated validation error list before PDF download, showing which required fields are missing or invalid

quotes: Please fix all validation errors before downloading PDF

acceptanceCriteria: All validation errors are collected and displayed together
Each error message clearly indicates which field or requirement is failing
Error display is visible and prominent when user attempts PDF download
PDF download is blocked until all validation errors are resolved

constraints: All validation must happen before PDF generation, not during or after
Validation errors must be user-friendly and clearly indicate what needs to be fixed
Existing invoice functionality and VAT calculation logic must not be affected
nonGoals: Backend data model changes for storing supplier information
Auto-filling supplier information from previous invoices
VAT number format validation beyond required field check
Invoice number uniqueness validation across all invoices
